description: This Java class, ConceptAnswerEditor, extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to handle serialization and deserialization of ConceptAnswer objects for web forms in the OpenMRS system. It supports retrieving ConceptAnswer objects by ID and UUID.

classes.name: ConceptAnswerEditor
classes.description: Handles property editing (serialization/deserialization) of ConceptAnswer objects, enabling conversion between object form and string form for web-based interactions.

methods.name: ConceptAnswerEditor
methods.description: Default constructor for the editor class.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptAnswer object by its database ID using the openmrs Context.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptAnswer object by its UUID using the openmrs Context.
